name: Gradient Maker
description: Design linear, radial and conic gradients with draggable colour stops, copy the CSS and save them as phone wallpapers.
prompt: A gradient designer with linear, radial and conic types, draggable colour stops on a bar, an angle slider, presets and random gradients, copying the CSS and saving the gradient as a phone wallpaper.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Diseña degradados lineales, radiales y cónicos con paradas de color que arrastras, copia el CSS y guárdalos como fondo de pantalla.
